exercises.q: What does за- add in загото́вить (“to store up, to lay in (stock)”)?
options: an action after which the object ends up behind some boundary, real or imagined
doing the action of the base word in advance, or to store
covering, or being covered, with something
exercises.why: The Russian Wiktionary lists загото́вить under this meaning of за-. Source: Russian Wiktionary, «за-», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/за-).

exercises.q: My doctor told me to stay in bed.
exercises.why: **предписал** — предписа́ть (perfective): to prescribe; to direct, to order. Wiktionary: пред- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: The doctor ordered her to go on a strict diet.
exercises.why: **предписал** — предписа́ть (perfective): to prescribe; to direct, to order. Wiktionary: пред- + писа́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to store up, to lay in (stock)
to warn, to let know beforehand
to foresee, to foreknow, to see coming
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: загото́вить — to store up, to lay in (stock); предупреди́ть — to warn, to let know beforehand; предписа́ть — to prescribe; предви́деть — to foresee, to foreknow, to see coming.
